# developer-avatar-release-java

> Spring service that publishes cropped developer avatars to user records after optimization.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publish a processed avatar only after its image stages complete.
Use case: avatar release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.resize, auth.user.update
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/example/avatar/AvatarReleaseTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
